Hi Amanda —

Quick note from our side after this morning's sync: we see the compliance eval items (data retention review + SOC2 evidence) slipping into the week of June 10, which pushes the acceptance gate beyond the original close window. To keep the program from losing momentum we drafted a compressed MAP and two mitigation lanes:

- Lane A (preferred): one-week sandbox extension + parallel security walkthroughs (Redwood SME + Nimble security)
- Lane B (fallback): staged acceptance (feature flag release for non-PII flows) + procurement provisional PO

I've attached the MAP (Nimble-MAP-v2.xlsx) with suggested owners and a proposed re-centered timeline. Can you confirm whether an extended sandbox is possible on your side and whether procurement can accept a provisional PO on a 30-day term?

If helpful, we can stand up a 30-minute exec readout Monday to lock answers and finalize the MAP owners.

- Jun 3: Redwood evidence playbook + checklist delivered (attached)
- Jun 4–7: Parallel contractor walkthroughs (SOC2 items)
- Jun 10: Final security sign-off (target)
- Jun 12: Acceptance call / final PO signoff
